description: Source code for a TeamsManagementClient class that manages team-related API interactions for LiteLLM proxy, including listing teams, paginated team listing, and retrieving available teams.

classes.name: TeamsManagementClient
classes.description: Client class for managing teams in LiteLLM proxy, providing methods to list teams, get paginated team lists, and fetch available teams.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the TeamsManagementClient with base URL and optional API key for authentication.

methods.name: _get_headers
methods.description: Constructs request headers, including authorization if API key is provided.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of teams that a user belongs to, with optional filtering by user ID and organization ID.

methods.name: list_v2
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated, optionally filtered and sorted list of teams.

methods.name: get_available
methods.description: Fetches a list of teams available for the user to join.
